name: B2B Agencies & Recruiters
description: Screens prospective clients against minimum project retainers, qualifies talent applications, and routes high-value opportunities.

knowledgeBase.title: Minimum Retainer & Scope
knowledgeBase.content: Our minimum monthly retainer is $5,000/month. We specialize in B2B SaaS growth marketing and full-funnel paid media.

knowledgeBase.title: Onboarding Timeline
knowledgeBase.content: Client kickoff takes 7 business days following contract signature and technical audit access.

knowledgeBase.title: Candidate Submissions
knowledgeBase.content: Recruiting candidates must include a resume and portfolio link. Applications are reviewed within 48 business hours.
